title: Hero stats
instruction: Build a game hero! Work out their HP from their level and print it. Then a slime hits them for 25 HP, and after that they eat a cookie that gives back 40 HP. Print the HP after each event.
hint: str() turns a number into text so you can join it with +. f-strings let you drop {variables} straight into text.

blocks.code: print("Level " + str(level) + " hero with " + str(hp) + " HP")
print(f"Ouch! A slime hit you. HP left: {hp}")
print(f"You ate a cookie. HP is now {hp}")

expectedOutput: Ouch! A slime hit you. HP left: 55
You ate a cookie. HP is now 95
